description: Stored inputs a fetch of the opt-in workflow may start from when no object is
stored for its key and the architecture has no 'latest' tag yet (ci/inputs.sh
seeds, seed). Each is the registry digest of one object an inputs job stored;
it names existing bytes and is never edited to make something pass. A seed
only saves downloads: fetch.sh compares every file with the pin of the recipe
that consumes it, and a file that does not match is downloaded again.
amd64 and arm64: stored by the inputs jobs of run 45743705418 (2026-11-26,
status/inputs.ref), the first objects written without the files of
inputs-not-stored.json. The seeds named here before (20b4e333..., 63c1651a...,
run 45714468510) held those files and are no longer referred to.
